title: Obbraghyn as ynsaghey
description: Ten short stories about jobs and training on the Isle of Man: a student teacher at a Manx-medium school, an X-ray trainee, a nature-conservation lab, a dark-sky guide, a sports journalist, a young priest's first funeral, a town library, a walking guide on the cliffs, a film crew and a trainee who cares for sick animals.

lessons.title: Yn ynseyder aeg
lessons.summary: Rhona, a student teacher, spends a week at a Manx-medium school in Doolish: an older teacher shows her how hard the spelling is for the children, explains lenition and the old word for it, a boy who speaks Arabic at home compares its first letter with the Greek alpha, and the class learns the short forms.
lessons.text:
Ta Rhona Comaish ynsaghey dy ve ny ynseyder. Ta'n ynsaghey eck goll er son daa vlein, as 'sy vee shoh hie ee dy obbraghey son shiaghtin ayns scoill veg ayns Doolish. Ta ynseyder shenn ayns y scoill, Margaret Dawson, as t'ee jeeaghyn da Rhona cre'n aght dy ynsaghey.

“Ta ny paitçhyn loayrt Gaelg dy mie,” dooyrt Margaret er y chied laa, “agh ta'n cairscreeu doillee daue. T'ad screeu fockle myr t'ad clashtyn eh, as cha nel y cairscreeu kinjagh myr shen.”

Va Rhona lhaih screeuyn ny paitçhyn. Va guilley ennagh er screeu “e thie” son “e hie”. “Shoh boggaghys,” dooyrt Margaret. “Lurg ‘e’, ta ‘thie’ çheet dy ve ‘hie’. T'eh raait dy re boggaghys yn red s'doillee 'sy Ghaelg.”

“Ayns lioaryn shenn,” dooyrt Margaret, “cha nel ad gra ‘boggaghys’. T'ad gra dy vel y lettyr ennalit. Agh she yn red cheddin t'ayn.”

Screeu Rhona ny fockle shoh ayns e lioar: boggaghys, ennalit, ennalaghey. “Ta'n ennalaghey caghlaa yn chied lettyr jeh'n fockle,” dooyrt ee rish hene.

Ayns y rang, va guilley beg enmyssit Yusuf. Ta Yusuf loayrt Gaelg ec y scoill, Baarle rish ny caarjyn echey, as Arabish ec y thie. Dooyrt Yusuf dy re Arabish çhengey e voir, as dy vel ee ynsaghey Arabish da.

“Ta lettyryn elley ec yn Arabish,” dooyrt Yusuf.

“Ayns Greagish, she alpha yn chied lettyr,” dooyrt Rhona. “Vel y chied lettyr 'syn Arabish cosoylagh rish alpha?”

“Ta,” dooyrt Yusuf.

Er y nah laa, ren Margaret aagherridyn y ynsaghey da'n rang. “Ta aagherrid ayns ‘ta'n’,” dooyrt ee. “She aagherrid son ‘ta yn’ t'ayn.” Va ny paitçhyn screeu aagherridyn er y boayrd.

Lurg y laa, dooyrt Rhona rish Margaret: “Va'n laa shoh feer ymmydoil dou. Va fys aym dy re boggaghys va ayn, agh cha row fys aym cre'n aght dy ynsaghey eh. T'eh raait dy vel y chied vlein doillee da dagh ynseyder.”

“T'eh raait er y fa dy vel eh firrinagh,” dooyrt Margaret. “Ta lioar ymmydoil aym son ynseyderyn noa.” Hug ee y lioar da Rhona. “Ta'n cairscreeu ooilley ayn, as ny aagherridyn neesht.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta Rhona ynsaghey dy ve?
T'ee ynsaghey dy ve ny ynseyder.
Cre ta doillee da ny paitçhyn?
Ta'n cairscreeu doillee daue.
Cre ta lioaryn shenn gra son boggaghys?
T'ad gra dy vel y lettyr ennalit.
Cre'n çhengey ta Yusuf loayrt ec y thie?
T'eh loayrt Arabish ec y thie.
Cre'n chied lettyr ayns Greagish?
She alpha yn chied lettyr ayns Greagish.

lessons.title: Jallooyn scell-X
lessons.summary: Aidan is training to take X-ray pictures in Doolish: his teacher Judith explains the radiation in the rays, they take a picture of an old man's lungs and of a girl's nose after she fell playing football, and Aidan watches blood being taken from a vein for a genetic test that comes back negative.
lessons.text:
Ta Aidan Webb ynsaghey dy ghoaill jallooyn scell ayns Doolish: jallooyn jeh craueyn as jeh'n corp stiagh. Ta'n ynsaghey echey goll er son three bleeaney, as nish t'eh gobbraghey lesh yn ynseyder echey, Judith Mercer.

“Tra ta'n scell goll trooid y corp, ta jalloo jeant jeh ny craueyn,” dooyrt Judith. “Agh ta goulraght ayns y scell. Cha nel agh beggan goulraght ayn, agh ta shin goaill kiarail. Ta shin kinjagh shassoo cooyl y voalley tra ta'n scell goll.”

Er y chied laa, haink shenn dooinney stiagh. Va'n dooinney ching, as va feme echey er jalloo jeh ny scowanyn echey. Hie eh dy hassoo roish y greie. “Gow ennal mooar,” dooyrt Aidan, “as freill yn ennal.” Ghow Aidan y jalloo.

Honnick Aidan ny scowanyn 'sy jalloo. Va ny scowanyn mooar as glen. “Vaik oo red erbee?” dooyrt eh rish Judith. “Cha vaik,” dooyrt Judith. “Ta ny scowanyn echey mie.”

Ec mean y laa, haink inneen veg stiagh lesh e moir. Huitt yn inneen tra v'ee cloie bluckan, as va'n stroin eck jiarg as mooar. “Vel y stroin eck brisht?” dooyrt y voir. Ghow Aidan jalloo jeh'n stroin. Honnick Judith as Aidan y jalloo. “Cha nel y stroin brisht,” dooyrt Judith.

Lurg shen, va Aidan jeeaghyn er Judith goaill fuill ass cuishlin. Hooar Judith y chuishlin ayns laue ben aeg. Va'n fuill son prowaltys. Va çhingys gientynagh ec ayr y ven aeg, as va ee laccal fys dy row yn çhingys gientynagh eck hene.

“Ta'n prowaltys shoh jeeaghyn er y fuill,” dooyrt Judith rish Aidan. “Ta çhingys gientynagh goll veih ny paarantyn gys ny paitçhyn.”

Lurg shiaghtin, haink fys veih'n prowaltys: va'n prowaltys jiooldagh. Cha row y çhingys ec y ven aeg. “Ta jiooldagh mie ayns shoh,” dooyrt Judith. “Ta prowaltys jiooldagh gra nagh vel y çhingys ayn.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta ayns y scell?
Ta beggan goulraght ayns y scell.
Cre honnick Aidan 'sy chied jalloo?
Honnick eh scowanyn y dooinney.
Row stroin yn inneen brisht?
Cha row. Cha row y stroin eck brisht.
Cre'n fa va'n ven aeg laccal prowaltys?
Va çhingys gientynagh ec e ayr.
Row'n prowaltys jiooldagh?
Va. Va'n prowaltys jiooldagh.

lessons.title: Y mynreayrtan
lessons.summary: Jodie starts training with a nature-conservation group: with Gregor she takes silt from the bottom of a lake, fungus from an old tree and soft plants from a field, then tries the microscope for the first time and learns why they measure the lake every year as the climate changes.
lessons.text:
Ta Jodie Harper ynsaghey dy obbraghey son sheshaght freayltys. Ta'n sheshaght freayltys coadey ny cretooryn as ny lossreeyn feie ayns Ellan Vannin. Ta Jodie ynsaghey lesh Gregor, ta er ve gobbraghey ec y sheshaght son feed blein.

Er y chied laa, ghow Gregor Jodie dys logh beg 'sy twoaie. Va baatey beg oc. Ren Gregor diunid y logh y howse. “Ta'n diunid ayns shoh mysh nuy trie,” dooyrt eh. “Ta shin goaill shill veih bun y logh, veih'n diunid shoh.”

Ghow ad shill veih bun y logh as hug ad eh ayns kishtey. Va'n shill doo as bog. Eisht hie ad dys billey shenn faggys da'n logh. Va fungys buigh er y billey. Hug Jodie peesh jeh'n fungys ayns kishtey elley.

Er y magher, va lossreeyn lussagh gaase. “Ta lossreeyn lussagh bog,” dooyrt Gregor. “Cha nel fuygh ayndaue, as t'ad baase 'sy gheurey.” Hug Jodie lossreeyn lussagh ayns y treeoo kishtey.

Haink ad erash dys y thie ec y sheshaght. Va mynreayrtan mooar er y boayrd. “Prow eh,” dooyrt Gregor. Cha row Jodie rieau er ve jeeaghyn trooid mynreayrtan. Ren ee y mynreayrtan y phrowal. Honnick ee cretooryn beggey 'sy shill, as reddyn beggey bane 'sy fungys.

“She shill sampleyragh t'ayn,” dooyrt Gregor. “Ta ny cretooryn shoh ayns dagh logh. As she fungys sampleyragh jeh ny keylljyn ain t'ayn neesht.”

“Cre'n fa ta shin goaill shill dagh blein?” dooyrt Jodie.

“Ta'n emshyraght caghlaa,” dooyrt Gregor. “Ta'n ushtey ny s'çheh na v'eh roish feed blein. Tra ta'n emshyraght caghlaa, ta ny cretooryn 'sy shill caghlaa neesht. Ta shin jeeaghyn er ny cretooryn dy akin cre'n aght ta'n emshyraght caghlaa yn logh.”

Ren Jodie y mynreayrtan y phrowal reesht. “S'mie lhiam yn obbyr shoh,” dooyrt ee. “She obbyr freayltys ymmydoil t'ayn.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta sheshaght freayltys jannoo?
T'ee coadey ny cretooryn as ny lossreeyn feie.
Cre hug ad ayns y chied kishtey?
Hug ad shill veih bun y logh ayns y chied kishtey.
Vel fuygh ayns lossreeyn lussagh?
Cha nel. Cha nel fuygh ayndaue.
Cre honnick Jodie 'sy fungys trooid y mynreayrtan?
Honnick ee reddyn beggey bane 'sy fungys.
Cre'n fa ta ny cretooryn 'sy shill caghlaa?
T'ad caghlaa er y fa dy vel yn emshyraght caghlaa.

lessons.title: Fo ny rollageyn
lessons.summary: Neville trains as a guide for a dark-sky group: on a clear night on a hill in the south he shows visitors how the stars move across the sky, draws circles on the ground for the Moon and the planets, explains the distances in kilometres and the space between them, and talks about planets around other stars.
lessons.text:
Ta Neville Booth ynsaghey dy ve ny fer-stiurey son club rollageydagh. Ta speyr dorraghey ec Ellan Vannin 'syn oie, as ta sleih çheet veih çheeraghyn elley dy akin ny rollageyn. Ta Neville goll lesh ny sleih shoh er slieau 'sy jiass, as t'eh gra roo mychione ny reddyn niauoilagh.

Ta ben shenn 'sy club, Marjorie, ta ynsaghey eh. Ta lioaryn rollageydagh ec Marjorie, as ta fys eck er ny reddyn niauoilagh ooilley.

Er yn oie shoh, va'n speyr glen as dorraghey. Haink kiare sleih jeig er y slieau. Ghow Neville ad dys boayl ard. “Jeeagh er ny rollageyn,” dooyrt eh. “Ta ny rollageyn gleashaghey 'sy speyr. Lurg amm giare, ta shin fakin dy vel ad er ghleashaghey.”

Va ny sleih jeeaghyn er ny rollageyn son amm. Eisht ren Neville kiarkyl er y thalloo lesh peesh dy fuygh. “Shoh yn ghrian,” dooyrt eh. Eisht ren eh sarkyl mooar mygeayrt y chiarkyl. “Ta'n thalloo goll mygeayrt y ghrian ayns y sarkyl shoh. Ta'n eayst goll mygeayrt y thalloo ayns sarkyl beg.”

“Cre cho foddey ta'n eayst voin?” dooyrt dooinney ennagh.

“Ta'n eayst mysh 384,000 kilometer voin,” dooyrt Neville. “As ta'n ghrian mysh 150 millioon kilometer voin. Ta reamys mooar eddyr ny reddyn niauoilagh. Ta'n reamys eddyr ny rollageyn ny smoo foast.”

Eisht honnick ad rollage gial 'sy niar. “Ta planaid mygeayrt y rollage shen,” dooyrt Neville. “She planaid neughrianagh t'ayn: planaid ta goll mygeayrt rollage elley, cha nel mygeayrt y ghrian ain. Ta thousaneyn dy phlanaidyn neughrianagh er nyn vakin nish.”

Lurg y turrys, dooyrt Marjorie rish Neville: “Va shen mie. Ren oo y kiarkyl as y sarkyl er y thalloo, as va ny sleih toiggal.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre'n fa ta sleih çheet dys Ellan Vannin dy akin ny rollageyn?
Ta speyr dorraghey ec Ellan Vannin 'syn oie.
Cre ren Neville lesh peesh dy fuygh?
Ren eh kiarkyl as sarkyl er y thalloo.
Cre cho foddey ta'n eayst voin?
Ta'n eayst mysh 384,000 kilometer voin.
Cre ta planaid neughrianagh?
She planaid ta goll mygeayrt rollage elley t'ayn.

lessons.title: Yn earisheyr spoyrt
lessons.summary: Abbie, a trainee journalist on a Doolish newspaper, is sent by her editor to a soccer match in the island league in Rhumsaa; she counts the goals, from the fifth to the sixth, writes her report at the tram stop, and learns the paper's policy on the labels under photographs.
lessons.text:
Ta Abbie Bennett ynsaghey dy ve ny earisheyr. T'ee gobbraghey son pabyr naight ayns Doolish. She Clive Parry reagheyder y phabyr. Ta Clive er ve ny earisheyr son feed blein, as ta'n reagheyder ynsaghey Abbie.

“Ta cloie soccer ayns Rhumsaa jiu,” dooyrt yn reagheyder. “Rhumsaa noi Pheeil 'sy lhing ellanagh. Ta mee laccal oo dy gholl dys y chloie, as dy screeu skeeal mychione. Bee'n skeeal creaghnit roish oie.”

Hie Abbie dys Rhumsaa er y traen lectragh. Va ram sleih ec y chloie. She y lhing ellanagh yn lhing smoo ayns soccer er yn ellan.

Va'n chloie mie. Ren Rhumsaa kiare goalyn. Ren Pheeil daa goal. Eisht, ren Rhumsaa y queiggoo goal, as tammylt beg ny lurg shen, ren ad y sheyoo goal. “Shey goalyn!” dooyrt dooinney faggys da Abbie. Va Abbie screeu ooilley ayns e lioar: yn queiggoo goal, yn sheyoo goal, as enmyn ny cloiederyn.

Lurg y chloie, hie Abbie dys stadd y traen. Va'n traen anmagh, as va Abbie soie ec y stadd. Screeu ee yn skeeal er y çhellvane eck. Va Abbie creaghnaghey yn skeeal ec y stadd, as va'n skeeal creaghnit roish my haink y traen.

Ec y thie, va Clive lhaih yn skeeal. “T'eh mie,” dooyrt eh. “Agh ta jallooyn ayd jeh ny cloiederyn. Ta feme ayd er cowragyn fo ny jallooyn.”

“Cre ta ny cowragyn?” dooyrt Abbie.

“Ta enmyn ny cloiederyn ayns ny cowragyn,” dooyrt Clive. “Agh ta polasee ain: cha nel shin screeu enmyn paitçhyn fo jallooyn. Ta'n polasee shen ayn rieau. Ta paitçhey 'sy jalloo shoh, mysh shey bleeaney d'eash. Cha nel ennym erbee fo'n phaitçhey.”

Screeu Abbie ny cowragyn as hug ee yn skeeal da'n reagheyder. Er y nah laa, va'n skeeal eck 'sy phabyr.

Feyshtyn:
Quoi yn reagheyder?
She Clive Parry yn reagheyder.
Cre'n chloie va ayns Rhumsaa?
Va cloie soccer ayn: Rhumsaa noi Pheeil 'sy lhing ellanagh.
Quoi ren y sheyoo goal?
Ren Rhumsaa y sheyoo goal.
Row'n skeeal creaghnit roish my haink y traen?
Va. Va Abbie creaghnaghey yn skeeal ec y stadd, as va'n skeeal creaghnit roish my haink y traen.
Cre ta polasee y phabyr?
Cha nel ad screeu enmyn paitçhyn fo jallooyn.

lessons.title: Yn chied oanluckey
lessons.summary: Dominic, a young priest in training, prepares his first funeral: an old grandfather who was married to his wife for sixty years; Dominic reads from the Bible, says a prayer, speaks about their love, and the widow and her grandson thank him afterwards.
lessons.text:
Ta Dominic Lamb ynsaghey dy ve ny saggyrt. T'eh gobbraghey ayns agglish ayns Pheeil, marish shenn saggyrt. 'Sy vee shoh, hooar shenn dooinney baase 'sy valley: Reginald, kiare feed as nuy bleeaney d'eash. Dooyrt y shenn saggyrt rish Dominic: “Nee oo yn oanluckey shoh. She yn chied oanluckey ayd.”

Hie Dominic dy akin ben Reginald, Winifred. Va Winifred as Reginald poost son tree feed blein. “Va shin poost ayns yn agglish shoh,” dooyrt Winifred. “Va Reginald yn sheshey share va rieau aym.” Va mac inneen Winifred, Tyler, ayns y thie neesht. “Va my shennayr kinjagh cloie lhiam ec y traie,” dooyrt Tyler. “Va'n shennayr aym feer vie dou.”

Va Dominic screeu ayns e lioar: poost son tree feed blein, yn sheshey share, shennayr mie.

Er laa yn oanluckey, va'n agglish lane. Lhaih Dominic veih'n vible. Va'n lioar shenn as trome: va'n vible shen ec Reginald as Winifred rieau. Eisht ren Dominic padjer. Va'n padjer giare, as cha dooyrt peiagh erbee fockle.

Eisht loayr Dominic mychione Reginald. “Va Reginald as Winifred poost son tree feed blein,” dooyrt eh. “Va graih vooar eddyr y daa sheshey. Va graih echey neesht er e chloan, as er e vac inneen, Tyler. She shennayr mie v'ayn.”

Lurg yn oanluckey, haink Winifred gys Dominic. “Ta mee cur booise dhyt,” dooyrt ee. “Va'n padjer ayd feer vie, as va ny fockle ayd mychione nyn ghraih firrinagh.” Haink Tyler neesht. “Booise dhyt son ny fockle mychione my shennayr,” dooyrt eh.

Lurg shen, dooyrt y shenn saggyrt rish Dominic: “Ren oo dy mie. Nee oo saggyrt mie.”

Feyshtyn:
Quoi hooar baase 'sy valley?
Hooar Reginald baase.
Cre cho foddey va Reginald as Winifred poost?
Va ad poost son tree feed blein.
Cre lhaih Dominic ec yn oanluckey?
Lhaih eh veih'n vible.
Cre dooyrt Tyler mychione e shennayr?
Dooyrt eh dy row e shennayr kinjagh cloie lesh ec y traie.
Cre dooyrt Winifred rish Dominic lurg yn oanluckey?
Dooyrt ee dy vel ee cur booise da.

lessons.title: Ayns y lioarlann
lessons.summary: Alys trains at the town library in Doolish: she makes a membership card for a new reader and writes down his address, finds books on a Chinese dynasty and its era for a student, fetches old papers on the Great Famine from the store room, and hears how the library got its name.
lessons.text:
Ta Alys Warren ynsaghey dy obbraghey ayns lioarlann. T'ee gobbraghey ayns lioarlann y valley ayns Doolish, as ta'n lioarlann shoh feer shenn.

Er y chied laa, haink dooinney aeg stiagh. “Ta mee laccal olteynys jeh'n lioarlann,” dooyrt eh. Ghow Alys yn ennym echey, Wesley, as e chummaltys. “Cre'n boayl t'ou cummal?” dooyrt ee. Screeu ee yn cummaltys echey er y kaart. Hug ee kaart olteynys da Wesley. “Lesh y kaart olteynys shoh, foddee oo goaill lioaryn magh,” dooyrt ee.

Ec mean y laa, haink studeyr veih'n ollooscoill. “Ta mee screeu mychione reeraghtys Han ayns ny Sheen,” dooyrt y studeyr. “Vel lioaryn ayd mychione y rey shen?” Hooar Alys lioar mychione y reeraghtys. “Va'n reeraghtys Han reill ny Sheen son kiare cheead blein,” dooyrt ee. “Ta'n lioar shoh mychione y rey ooilley.” Hooar ee lioar elley mychione ellyn ny Sheen 'sy rey cheddin.

Lurg mean y laa, haink shenn ven stiagh. Va'n ven laccal fys mychione y Ghortey Vooar ayns Nerin. “Hooar ram sleih baase 'sy ghortey shen,” dooyrt y ven. “Va'n moir aym ass Nerin.”

Cha row lioar erbee mychione y ghortey ec Alys. Hie Alys sheese dys y stoyr. Ayns y stoyr, ta lioaryn shenn as pabyryn naight shenn. Hooar ee pabyryn veih'n traa shen, as hug ee ad da'n ven. “Ta ny pabyryn shoh 'sy stoyr son keead as kiare feed blein,” dooyrt ee.

Lurg y laa, dooyrt Alys rish yn ynseyder eck: “Cre'n fa ta'n ennym shoh er y lioarlann?” “Ren y valley y lioarlann y enmyssey er dooinney berçhagh,” dooyrt yn ynseyder. “Hug eh argid son y thie. Ren ad y thie y enmyssey er e hon.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre ghow Alys veih Wesley son y kaart?
Ghow ee yn ennym echey as e chummaltys.
Cre'n reeraghtys va'n studeyr screeu mychione?
V'eh screeu mychione reeraghtys Han ayns ny Sheen.
Cre va'n shenn ven laccal?
Va ee laccal fys mychione y Ghortey Vooar ayns Nerin.
Cre'n boayl hooar Alys ny pabyryn shenn?
Hooar ee ad 'sy stoyr.

lessons.title: Er y cassan
lessons.summary: Craig trains as a walking guide: he leads a group up a mountainous path above the cliffs, shows them a cairn and tells them the old story of a man who hid stolen sheep and was hanged, lends a woman his walking stick, and brings everyone to an inn where the host has food ready.
lessons.text:
Ta Craig Holmes ynsaghey dy ve ny fer-stiurey son sleih ta shooyl 'sy çheer. Er y laa shoh, ta Craig goll lesh possan dy hoght sleih er cassan liauyr 'sy jiass.

Ta'n cassan shoh sleitagh. T'eh goll seose as sheese harrish ny croink, as eisht t'eh goll faggys da ny eayninyn ec y keayn. “Jean-jee geiyrt dou,” dooyrt Craig, “as ny gow-jee ro faggys da'n eaynin. Ta'n eaynin shoh ard.”

Va ny sleih geiyrt da Craig er y cassan. Va slattag ec Craig, as va'n slattag mie da er y cassan sleitagh. Va ben ennagh, Rosemary, geiyrt da dy faggys. Dooyrt ee dy row ny cassyn eck trome. Hug Craig y slattag echey j'ee. “Gow y slattag shoh,” dooyrt eh. “T'eh ny s'aashagh shooyl lesh slattag.”

Er mullagh y slieau, va carnane mooar. Hug dagh peiagh clagh er y charnane. “Ta skeeal shenn mychione y carnane shoh,” dooyrt Craig. “Roish daa cheead blein, va dooinney cummal 'sy glion shoh. Ghow eh kirree veih'n eirinagh, as ren eh ny kirree y foll ayns towl mooar fo'n eaynin. Va ny kirree follit ayns shen son shiaghtin. Agh hooar ny sleih ny kirree, as va'n dooinney croghit. V'eh currit gy baase faggys da'n carnane shoh.”

“V'eh croghit son kirree?” dooyrt Rosemary.

“Va,” dooyrt Craig. “Ayns ny laghyn shen, va sleih currit gy baase son red beg.”

Lurg three ooryn, haink ad sheese dys thie oast beg 'sy glion. Va'n oast, dooinney mooar lesh folt bane, ec y thie, as va bee çheh ec yn oast son dagh peiagh. Hug Rosemary y slattag erash da Craig. “Booise dhyt,” dooyrt ee. “Va'n slattag feer vie dou.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre'n sorçh dy chassan t'ayn?
She cassan sleitagh t'ayn.
Cre hug Craig da Rosemary?
Hug eh y slattag echey j'ee.
Cre va er mullagh y slieau?
Va carnane mooar er mullagh y slieau.
Cre ren y dooinney lesh ny kirree?
Ren eh ny kirree y foll ayns towl mooar fo'n eaynin.
Quoi va ec y thie oast?
Va'n oast ec y thie, as va bee çheh echey.

lessons.title: Yn scannane
lessons.summary: Sienna trains as a painter on a film crew in Purt ny h-Inshey: she paints the background for a story film about a quarrel that once split the town, the crew needs legal permission to film in the street, an actor's tie goes missing, and at the end the film is entered in a festival where the audience asks questions.
lessons.text:
Ta Sienna Fisher ynsaghey scannaneaght ec y cholleish. Ta'n ynsaghey eck mychione peint as ellyn. 'Sy tourey shoh, t'ee gobbraghey lesh possan ta jannoo scannane ayns Purt ny h-Inshey.

She scannane skeealagh t'ayn: skeeal mychione y valley roish keead blein. S'mie lesh Sienna scannaneyn skeealagh, scannaneyn lesh skeeal mie aynjee. Ayns y skeeal, va'n choonceil laccal raad noa y yannoo trooid y valley. Va'n chooish scarreydagh: va lieh ny sleih son y raad, as va'n lieh elley noi. Ren y chooish scarreydagh shen rheynn 'sy valley son bleeantyn.

She obbyr Sienna y cooylrey y yannoo. Ren ee cooylrey mooar lesh peint: thieyn shenn, purt, as baatyn. Va'n peint gorrym as glass as bane. “T'eh feer vie,” dooyrt fer-stiurey yn scannane, Rupert. “Ta'n cooylrey shoh jeeaghyn myr y valley roish keead blein.”

Va'n possan laccal y scannane y ghoaill er y straid. Agh cha row shen leighoil gyn kied. Hie Rupert dys y choonceil dy gheddyn kied leighoil. Lurg shiaghtin, hooar eh y kied. “Nish t'eh leighoil,” dooyrt eh.

Er y laa, va dooinney 'sy scannane goaill ayrn shenn dooinney berçhagh. Va eaddagh doo as carvat ruy echey. Agh roish y scannane, va'n carvat ersooyl. Ren Sienna carvat noa jeh peesh dy eaddagh ruy. “Cha nel fys ec peiagh erbee nagh nee yn carvat cheddin t'ayn,” dooyrt Rupert.

Tra va'n scannane jeant, hug Rupert entreil er son y scannane gys feaill scannaneaght ayns Nalbin. Va'n entreil currit roish y jerrey jeh'n vee. Lurg y scannane ec y feaill, va feyshtyn ec ny sleih. Va feyshtyn ec ben ennagh mychione y cooylrey. “She Sienna ren y cooylrey lesh peint,” dooyrt Rupert. Va Sienna freggyrt ny feyshtyn.

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta Sienna ynsaghey?
T'ee ynsaghey scannaneaght.
Cre'n fa va'n chooish scarreydagh?
Va lieh ny sleih son y raad, as va'n lieh elley noi.
Cre ren Sienna lesh peint?
Ren ee cooylrey mooar lesh peint.
Cre va feme ec y possan dy ve leighoil?
Va feme oc er kied veih'n choonceil.
Cre ren Sienna tra va'n carvat ersooyl?
Ren ee carvat noa jeh peesh dy eaddagh ruy.

lessons.title: Kiarail son cretooryn
lessons.summary: Tamsin trains to care for sick animals in Rhumsaa: she puts on her white coat, boils water to clean the tools, helps a bird with a broken beak, cares for a female monkey from the wildlife park and a dog burnt by a garden fire, and learns what the price of each visit would be.
lessons.text:
Ta Tamsin Moss ynsaghey dy chur kiarail da cretooryn ching. T'ee gobbraghey ayns thie beg ayns Rhumsaa, raad ta sleih goll lesh nyn moddee as nyn gayt.

Dagh laa, ta Tamsin cur e cooat bane urree. Ta'n cooat bane glen. Eisht t'ee broie ushtey dy ghlenney ny greieyn. “Ta shin kinjagh broie yn ushtey,” dooyrt yn ynseyder eck. “Ta ushtey broieit glen.”

Er y chied laa, haink guilley beg stiagh lesh ushag. Va gob yn ushag brisht. Ren Tamsin gob yn ushag y ghlenney, as hug ee yn ushag ayns kishtey çheh. “Lurg shiaghtin, bee'n gob mie,” dooyrt yn ynseyder.

Ec mean y laa, haink ben veih'n pairk cretooryn feie lesh apag. Va'n apag ching. “Vel yn apag shoh bwoirryn?” dooyrt Tamsin. “Ta,” dooyrt y ven. “T'ee bwoirryn, as t'ee three bleeaney d'eash.” Cha row yn apag laccal çheet faggys da Tamsin, agh lurg tammylt, ghow yn apag bee veih laue Tamsin.

Lurg mean y laa, haink dooinney stiagh lesh moddey. Va'n dooinney er ve lostey duillagyn 'sy gharey, as hie'n moddey ro faggys da'n aile. Va'n aile er lostey cass y voddey. “Ta'n lostey shen er ve drogh red da'n moddey,” dooyrt yn ynseyder.

Lurg y laa, va Tamsin screeu yn leagh son dagh cretoor. “Cre veagh yn leagh son yn ushag?” dooyrt ee. “Veagh yn leagh beg son ushag,” dooyrt yn ynseyder. “Agh cha nel shin goaill leagh erbee son ushagyn feie.”

“She persoon mie oo,” dooyrt Tamsin.

“Ta graih ec dagh persoon ayns yn obbyr shoh er cretooryn,” dooyrt yn ynseyder. “Mannagh row graih ayd er cretooryn, veagh oo ayns obbyr elley.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta Tamsin cur urree dagh laa?
T'ee cur e cooat bane urree.
Cre'n fa ta Tamsin broie ushtey?
T'ee broie ushtey dy ghlenney ny greieyn.
Cre va brisht er yn ushag?
Va gob yn ushag brisht.
Row'n apag bwoirryn?
Va. Va'n apag bwoirryn.
Cre ren y dooinney 'sy gharey?
V'eh lostey duillagyn 'sy gharey.
